tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Past experience in the format mentioned under Section XII along with experience certificates/work orders.
The Tenderer shall be either proprietorship or partnership firm or a company registered under the companies Act 1956 or a registered society
The Tenderer should be registered under the Department of Small Scale Industries

Copy of the PAN card of the firm has to be uploaded as detailed below, If a firm is sole proprietorship PAN card copy of the proprietorship, If a firm is partnership PAN card copy of the firm only (partners PAN card copy will not be considered If a firm is private Ltd., or Public Ltd., Company, PAN card copy of the company.
Audited balance sheet and Profit and Loss account for last three financial years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 (i.e., Assessment Year 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 respectively). has to be uploaded

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: EMD of Rs. 15,205/- should be credited to CeG account as per IFT Clause (4).
Details of Income Tax returns filed for last three financial years 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 (i.e., Assessment Year 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 respectively).has to be uploaded.
Documents to prove the ownership of printing machines

The tenderer shall submit samples of the Paper to the Senior Assistant Director, B Section, Karnataka School Examination and Assessment Board as mentioned in e-procurement portal. These samples are to be packed in separate covers duly indicating name and address of the tenderer on the sealed cover and on all the samples. The tenders without the samples shall be categorically rejected. The samples shall bare the manufacturers name, brand, GSM etc.

The turnover of last three financial years from 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 (i.e., Assessment Year 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 respectively).sh-ould not be less than Rs.7.61 lakhs on an average per annum.
